portada.édit es una app de estilismo personal. D: édit is a personal styling app. You digitize your closet, create looks with the clothes you already own and, if you like, work with an image consultant. All in one place, so you can dress with more intention and less effort.
portada.¿Cómo digitalizo mi armario?: How do I digitize my closet?
portada.Sube una foto tuya de cuerpo entero y éd: Upload a full-length photo of you and édit picks out the clothes you’re wearing, or take a photo of each item. édit recognizes it and sorts it by type, color and season, and you check its details before saving. With just a few items you can start putting outfits together. More in {0}édit’s digital closet{/0}.
portada.¿Tengo que comprar ropa nueva?: Do I have to buy new clothes?
portada.No. édit empieza por lo que ya tienes: t: No. édit starts with what you already own: it helps you rediscover forgotten pieces and find new combinations. And when you do want to shop, it helps you see what’s really missing from your closet.
portada.édit te propone combinaciones con tus pr: édit suggests combinations with your own clothes, planned around your week, the weather and how you want to feel. You can also put together your own looks, save them and wear them again whenever you like.
portada.¿Puedo preparar un viaje o un evento?: Can I plan a trip or an event?
portada.Sí. Con los planes organizas un viaje, u: Yes. With plans you organize a trip, an event or a season: you choose the looks for each day and check off what’s already in your suitcase.
portada.¿Cómo trabaja conmigo una asesora de ima: How does an image consultant work with me?
portada.Puedes explorar asesoras de imagen profe: You can browse professional image consultants, see their looks and choose the one who’s right for you. She works on your real closet and sends you her suggestions inside the app. Technology amplifies her judgment; it doesn’t replace it. More in {0}online image consultant{/0}.
portada.Es el estudio digital para asesoras de i: It’s the digital studio for image consultants, stylists and {0}personal shoppers{/0}. It brings together each client’s profile and closet, looks, capsules and proposals, so you can work in a more visual, organized way. More in {1}édit professionals{/1}.
